limitations: Square-number zero gaps, a locally constant marker-count potential, and the positive-activity equilibrium only. The zero-activity extension is a smooth analytic-variable continuation, not an equilibrium at negative activity. Earlier unindexed theta/renewal pressure calculations might subsume the specific boundary law.
scientific_integrity: A mathematical proof and reproducible numerical diagnostics are provided. Numerical diagnostics do not establish the infinite theorem or historical priority. The self-review is separate from any independent evaluation.
title: Smooth but nonanalytic zero-activity pressure in a square-gap symbolic system
